Show a level as hair growing into a big afro

Source: R/hair_growth.R
hair_growth.Rd

Draws a portrait whose hair grows with a level between 0 and 1: the person is bald at 0 (with a shiny head), gets stubble, a buzz cut, short curls and curly hair, and has a big afro, with an afro pick, at 1. The face smiles more as the hair grows. When the chart scrolls into view, the hair grows from nothing to the level while the percentage above the portrait counts up and the current stage is written under it.

Usage

hair_growth(
  fill_level = 0.5,
  hair_color = "#2e2530",
  skin_color = "#a86b4f",
  shirt_color = "#3f51b5",
  panel_color = "#dde7ec",
  render_fill_label = TRUE,
  label_color = "#333",
  label_font_size = NULL,
  title_text = "Hair growth",
  title_color = "#333",
  title_font_size = 14,
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  target = NULL,
  sway = TRUE,
  draggable = FALSE,
  animate = TRUE,
  bg_col = "white",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

fill_level

A number between 0 and 1: how much hair the person has (values outside are clamped). 0 is bald and 1 is a big afro. Defaults to 0.5.

hair_color

The colour of the hair and the eyebrows. Defaults to "#2e2530".

skin_color

The colour of the skin. Defaults to "#a86b4f".

shirt_color

The colour of the turtleneck. Defaults to "#3f51b5".

panel_color

The colour of the card behind the portrait. Defaults to "#dde7ec"; use NULL for no card.

render_fill_label

Logical. Show the percentage and the stage above the portrait. Defaults to TRUE.

label_color

The colour of the percentage, the stage and the target. Defaults to "#333".

label_font_size

Optional. The font size of the percentage, a number or a CSS size such as "16px". By default it grows with the chart.

title_text

Optional. A caption below the portrait. Defaults to "Hair growth"; use NULL to hide it.

title_color

The colour of the caption. Defaults to "#333".

title_font_size

The font size of the caption, a number or a CSS size such as "14px". Defaults to 14.

font

The font family. Defaults to "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif".

target

Optional. A level between 0 and 1, drawn as a dashed outline of the hair at that level and written in the top right corner.

sway

Logical. Let the hair move gently, the person breathe and blink. Defaults to TRUE.

draggable

Logical. Let the viewer change the level by dragging or with the arrow keys. Defaults to FALSE.

animate

Logical. Grow the hair from nothing when the chart first comes into view. Defaults to TRUE.

bg_col

The background colour. Defaults to "white".

width

Optional. The width of the chart.

height

Optional. The height of the chart.

Value

An r2d3 htmlwidget.

Interactions

  • Move the mouse across the chart: the eyes follow it.

  • Hover the portrait: the hair bounces a little.

  • Click the portrait: the hair bounces and the person winks (a bald head shines).

  • With draggable = TRUE, drag up or down on the portrait to grow or cut the hair, or focus the chart (click it or press Tab) and use the arrow keys (1 percent per press, 10 with Shift).

Shiny

Inside Shiny, with r2d3::d3Output("id") and r2d3::renderD3(), clicking the portrait sets input$id_clicked to a list with value and stage, and, with draggable = TRUE, setting a level sets input$id_value to the new level (a number between 0 and 1). When the chart is re-rendered with a new level, the hair grows or shrinks from the old level to the new one.

Examples

hair_growth(fill_level = 1)


hair_growth(0.35, target = 0.8, title_text = "Fundraising goal")


hair_growth(
  fill_level = 0.6,
  hair_color = "#6b3e26",
  skin_color = "#f1c7a5",
  shirt_color = "#3ca951",
  panel_color = "#fdf1e3",
  draggable = TRUE,
  title_text = "Drag up to grow the hair"
)
